title: Fix MemoryScorer weights normalization
description: MemoryScorer weights sum to 1.23 (0.63 + 0.3 + 0.2 + 0.1) instead of 1.0. The References.Count term (weight 0.2) is an unnormalized raw count, so a record with 5 references scores +1.0 instantly hitting Working threshold. Normalize weights to sum to 1.0, normalize References.Count (log or cap), and re-calibrate WorkingThreshold/CoreThreshold. Check downstream callers that may have thresholds tuned to the broken formula. Source: codebase-audit-20260710-swarm-synthesis P0-001
